query: Export all codeunits in the 50000-50099 range from the DEV database on SQLSRV01 to a text file.
expected_behavior: Runs Invoke-NavObjects.ps1 with -Command Export, a Type=Codeunit;ID=50000..50099 filter, and a .txt path
Performs the dry run first and shows the exact finsql arguments before passing -Execute
Notes that .txt export requires a developer license

query: Import this objects.fob into the production NAV database.
expected_behavior: Treats production import as high-stakes: reviews the dry run and confirms before -Execute
Knows .fob import works with an end-user license (unlike .txt)
Derives success from navcommandresult/naverrorlog rather than the unreliable finsql exit code

query: finsql.exe isn't on this machine - can I still deploy objects?
expected_behavior: Explains finsql.exe ships with the NAV 2009 Classic client and cannot be auto-installed
Offers -FinSqlPath for a non-standard location, or running the skill on a machine with the Classic client
Does not silently fall back to writing raw SQL against NAV object tables
